headline: Indian IT services showed mixed revenue growth with AI driving pockets of strong performance.
summary: Coforge led the quarter with over 50% revenue growth, while Infosys and HCLTech posted modest double‑digit growth. AI‑related revenue rose sharply at several firms, supporting profit expansion at HCLTech and TCS. Guidance was trimmed at Infosys but raised at Coforge. Overall profitability remained solid, though some peers saw profit pressure.

themes.title: AI‑enabled services gaining traction
themes.detail: Infosys, HCLTech, TCS and LTM reported double‑digit AI revenue growth, contributing to higher margins and deal wins.

themes.title: Revenue growth divergence
themes.detail: Coforge posted 53.6% YoY growth, while larger peers like Infosys and Wipro grew in the low‑teens, highlighting a split between fast‑growing niche players and mature scale players.

leaders.why: 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised EBIT margin guidance to 16%.
11.5% YoY revenue growth, 21% profit jump and strong AI revenue of $219 m.

laggards.why: Revenue grew 30% but profit fell 25% YoY, indicating margin stress.
Revenue up 9.1% YoY but profit down 1.9% and headcount reduced.
